summary: helpers.go: removed the unused generated helpers requiredInputWaived, hasChangedLocalFlags, retainCLIQueryParams and retainExplicitQueryParams (and reworded the paginatedGet comment that named one of them); writeEncodedJSON now undoes the HTML escapes json.Marshal adds, so '&', '<' and '>' print as themselves in --json and --agent output. json_unescape_test.go covers the new helper.
reason: The EDEKA commands are hand-written against the portal client instead of the generated endpoint mirrors, so the removed helpers had no caller (dogfood dead-code WARN, scorecard dead code 2/5). The output review flagged product names such as 'Tchibo Black & White' printed with the ampersand as a unicode escape; every json.Marshal in the output pipeline adds that escape, so the single final writer removes it.
